behavior.instructions: Select the next action to continue cleaning using the observed situation. Resume forward motion when path is clear. Take action when a path is blocked (turning left or right) until path is clear. If the bumper is pressed, reverse to release the contact before continuing or turning. Previous behavior is history, not the desired action. Use the recent decisions and continuous waiting duration to detect lack of progress. Repeated waiting does not clear a static obstacle: select an appropriate movement when sensor readings permit it. Never override unknown sensors just to avoid waiting.

criteria.CONTINUE: Advance to clean if path is clear (bumper not pressed).
criteria.SLOW_DOWN: Advance cautiously if there is a close obstacle.
criteria.BACK_UP: Reverse to release contact if bumper is pressed.
criteria.WAIT: Pause briefly only for an observed temporary hazard or unknown sensor readings. Reassess at the next decision; do not keep waiting just because previous decisions were WAIT. Once readings are valid, resume advancing if clear, reverse for pressed bumper, or turn for a persistent obstruction.
